baseline.limitation: independent live server instances do not automatically observe each other's in-memory mutations

adoption.mechanism: per-room filesystem lock plus atomic save; independent process startup/read proof

value.reason: file locking prevents simultaneous file clobbering but does not make each process memory authority observe live mutations; full shared persistence semantics require read-through/invalidation or a shared authoritative store integration.

next_boundary: Derive and authorize minimal cross-process state refresh/authority architecture, or accept a broader persistence-store decision; no external dependency selected.
